spec_match.rationale: Measures live bounding-box compaction between display-mode="default" and display-mode="icon-only" while demonstrating UA CSS style boundary enforcement (minimum hit area, opacity=1.0, and contrast clamping).

interactive.rationale: Users can adjust font-size and inline padding sliders and trigger four CSS guardrail override scenarios with live getBoundingClientRect() measurements.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the index card description: interactive geometry & UA style boundary inspector measuring bounding-box compaction and testing CSS guardrails.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers sub-threshold font-size (10px), tiny hit-box attempts (14x14px), translucent opacity (0.15), and low-contrast author rules.

references.rationale: Links to chromestatus.com/feature/5107682460696576, W3C Media Capture HTML Elements spec, and explainer.

conformance.rationale: Verifies both IDL reflection and positive width compaction delta (defaultWidth > iconWidth).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified getBoundingClientRect measurements, guardrail scenario switches, and zero console errors or horizontal overflow.

telemetry_health.rationale: Emits capability-sizing-inspector-probe assertion with measured defaultWidth, iconWidth, savedPct, and activeGuard.

design_system.rationale: Tokenized /public/styles.css variables, explicit background+color on buttons, and 44px minimum target heights.

accessibility.rationale: Labeled range inputs, aria-pressed state on guardrail buttons, and aria-live readout summarizing measured geometry.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Responsive auto-fit cards keep both 360px mobile and 1280px desktop viewports clean and overflow-free.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Measure and adapt interactive control geometry while preserving minimum 44x44px touch targets across device classes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Demonstrated how display-mode="icon-only" compacts horizontal width by ~65% while preserving a 44x44px minimum touch area.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic <fieldset>/<legend> groupings and explicit <label for> associations on all range controls.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Bound font-slider and pad-slider to explicit labels with live value readouts inside fieldsets.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Expose visual geometry measurements and guardrail state changes via text tables and aria-live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Added a structured measurement table and polite live region narrating bounding-box savings and UA clamping.

summary: Interactive geometry and UA CSS guardrail inspector measuring bounding-box compaction between default and icon-only capability elements.
